purpose: Prospectively specify a current-campaign clean-room diagnostic control bench and a compute-bounded Phase 2A assessment of T1-T8 without importing R4 execution artifacts or scientific outcomes.

software_contract.neurolib_role: environment compatibility and future adapter boundary only; no repository or historical neurolib model is imported
software_contract.reason_for_single_process: The frozen environment snapshot admits one process at captured available memory.

bench.bench_type: clean-room reduced thalamocortical stochastic rate model

timebase.integrator: fixed-step stochastic Heun for rate/adaptation states with exact discrete OU update
timebase.predictor_corrector_order: Compute OU next state from the registered epsilon; Euler-predict r and a using current eta; recompute drift at predictor using next eta; set state_next=state+0.5*dt*(drift_current+drift_predictor).
timebase.decimation_rule: store every fifth internal sample after warmup; no antialias filter is needed for stored states because detector bands end at 30 Hz, but a fixed scipy.signal.decimate FIR zero-phase check must agree within 1 percent on preflight spectra
timebase.time_origin: intervention starts after warmup at analysis t=0
timebase.input_evaluation: For each internal solver interval m=0,...,209999 at global time t=m/1000 s, evaluate every additive input at the left endpoint and hold it constant over [m,m+1). Use the same held input in the current and Heun predictor drift. Analysis-relative index a=m-30000 is used below; all intervention inputs are exactly zero when a<0 or a>=180000.

randomness.seed_pairing: For a given parameter draw and seed, sham and every intervention condition reuse the identical four OU innovation streams.
randomness.stream_layout: One Generator(seed) produces a float64 array in C order with columns E,I,T,R at each internal step.
randomness.interpretation: seed and parameter draws quantify synthetic bench uncertainty only; they are not people and not personalization evidence

intervention_semantics.name_requirement: Every applied input is named GENERIC EXTERNAL FORCING.

causal_phase_scheduler.scope: Exact scheduler for GF_T_PHASE_LOCKED_PACKET only. Offline T6/T7 measurement filters remain the separately frozen zero-phase filters.
causal_phase_scheduler.sample_origin: Scheduler sample n=0 is simulation time -30.000 s; analysis begins at n=6000 and ends before n=42000.
causal_phase_scheduler.input: Raw online x[n]=(r_E[n]+0.25*r_T[n])/10 at every fifth 1 ms solver step; no future centering or zero-phase filtering.

causal_filter.type: one-pole high-pass at 0.3 Hz followed by one-pole low-pass at 1.5 Hz
causal_filter.initialization: At n=0 set x_prev=x[0], hp[0]=0, bp[0]=0. For n>=1 update hp first, then bp, then set x_prev=x[n].
causal_filter.delay_semantics: The causal filtered upward crossing itself defines phase zero; no estimated or subtracted filter delay is permitted.

warmup_and_history.history_rule: Crossings during samples 4000 through 5999 may build period history. Only crossings n>=6000 may schedule packets.

crossing_rule.candidate: bp[n-1]<0 and bp[n]>=0; equality at bp[n-1] is not a crossing; crossing time is integer sample n with no interpolation.
crossing_rule.invalid_interval_action: Log PERIOD_OUT_OF_RANGE, replace the prior anchor with n, clear all period intervals, and do not schedule from this crossing.
crossing_rule.valid_interval_action: Append n-last_anchor to a FIFO containing at most the three most recent valid intervals, set last_anchor=n, and mark n accepted.
crossing_rule.first_anchor_action: Store n as last_anchor, clear interval history, log FIRST_ANCHOR, and do not schedule.

period_estimation.estimator: P_hat is the integer median of the three stored valid integer intervals; because there are exactly three, no fractional median occurs.
period_estimation.insufficient_history_action: Log INSUFFICIENT_PERIOD_HISTORY and do not schedule.

phase_to_delay.canonicalization: phi_c=((phi+pi) mod (2*pi))-pi; an exact +pi input is prohibited and -pi is its sole representative.
phase_to_delay.forward_phase: q=((phi_c mod (2*pi))+2*pi) mod (2*pi), so q is in [0,2*pi).
phase_to_delay.quantization: d_round=floor(d_real+0.5), a deterministic round-half-up for nonnegative d_real.
phase_to_delay.causal_minimum_latency: d=max(1,d_round); the scheduler runs after x[n] is observed, so the earliest packet begins at n+1.
phase_to_delay.negative_offset_semantics: Negative phi maps through q to the remaining fraction of the current estimated cycle and is therefore scheduled after the detected crossing; for example -pi/2 maps to 3*P_use/4. It never refers to an already elapsed phase.
phase_to_delay.next_cycle_semantics: If q is numerically zero only phi_c=0 is allowed and the one-sample causal latency applies. No extra cycle is added. All negative offsets use the forward modulo delay within the cycle ending at the next predicted crossing.

queue_and_overlap.interval_convention: A packet occupies internal steps [j_start,j_start+500), equivalent to scheduler time [s,s+100 samples).
queue_and_overlap.overlap_rule: Before insertion, compare the half-open proposed interval with every active or queued interval. If max(start_a,start_b)<min(stop_a,stop_b), log OVERLAP_SKIP and discard the new packet; packets are never summed, truncated, merged, or replaced.
queue_and_overlap.queue_order: Nonoverlapping packets are stored by ascending start step; equal starts would overlap and the earlier-created packet remains.
queue_and_overlap.queue_full_rule: If two future packets are already queued, log QUEUE_FULL and discard the new packet even if it would not overlap.
queue_and_overlap.analysis_boundary_rule: Internal step zero is simulation start; warmup ends at j_analysis_start=30*1000=30000 and analysis ends at j_analysis_stop=210*1000=210000. If j_start<30000 or j_start+500>210000, log OUTSIDE_ANALYSIS_SKIP and discard the packet.

packet_samples.injection: u_T[j_start+k]=A*w[k]*c[k;f_c], with u_E=u_I=u_R=0 for this channel; endpoints w[0] and w[499] are exactly zero.
packet_samples.evaluation: Compute float64 values at integer k in ascending order. No phase reset other than k=0 at each packet, no interpolation, normalization, clipping, or overlap summation.

causal_phase_scheduler.missed_trigger_rule: Every accepted or rejected crossing receives exactly one decision code; skipped triggers are retained in the run artifact and never silently retried.

level_a.phi_c: one of the eight registered unique canonical phases

parameterization.combination_rule: T6 varies A only with f_c=13; T7 varies f_c only with A=1. No run varies both A and f_c, and no other forcing channel is combined with GF_T_PHASE_LOCKED_PACKET.
parameterization.sham_rule: A=0 is exact zero input: do not enqueue packets, but run the causal filter and crossing logger with decision code ZERO_AMPLITUDE_SHAM at every otherwise schedulable crossing.
parameterization.scheduler_state_invariance: Filter, crossing, period, phase-to-delay, latency, queue, overlap, and boundary rules are identical for every allowed A and f_c.

common_preprocessing.centering: subtract the mean of the 180 s analysis interval separately for each run
common_preprocessing.filter_implementation: For each registered band [lo,hi], call scipy.signal.butter(4,[lo,hi],btype='bandpass',analog=False,output='sos',fs=200.0), then scipy.signal.sosfiltfilt(sos,x,padtype='odd',padlen=None). Filter the full centered 180 s record once; metrics then apply the exact edge/window masks.
common_preprocessing.condition_invariance: All coefficients, thresholds, duration rules, and edge rules are fixed before non-sham outcomes and applied unchanged across the paired sham and intervention conditions.

T1.metric: dominant slow-oscillation peak frequency plus frequency-lock validation
T1.peak_refinement: three-bin parabolic interpolation in log power; use the discrete bin at either boundary
T1.locking: PLV=abs(mean(exp(i*(phase_SO-2*pi*f_drive*t)))) after the edge exclusion; phase_SO is the Hilbert phase of the 0.3-1.5 Hz filtered signal
T1.validity: Welch power finite and positive, peak not at 0.4 or 1.5 Hz, at least 30 valid SO cycles

T2_T3_SO_events.event_containment: both cycle boundaries and extrema must lie strictly inside the analysis interval after edge exclusion
T2_T3_SO_events.zero_event_rule: T3 density is zero if retained duration is valid; T2 is NOT_ESTIMABLE if fewer than 30 events

T4_T5_spindle_events.envelope: At stored fs=200 Hz, let y be the frozen 11-16 Hz signal and define rms[n]=sqrt(mean(y[k]^2 for k=n-19,...,n+20)), exactly 40 samples with 19 before and 20 after n. Samples lacking the full 40-sample support are invalid; they already lie outside the 10 s retained edge. No convolution-mode or alternate even-window centering is permitted.
T4_T5_spindle_events.threshold_calibration: For each seed-draw block, threshold constants are derived once from its sham: high=median+3*MAD and low=median+1.5*MAD, MAD=1.4826*median(abs(x-median(x))). The same constants are applied to every condition in that block.
T4_T5_spindle_events.event_rule: start on high-threshold crossing, extend to surrounding low-threshold crossings, merge gaps <=0.100 s, retain durations 0.300-2.000 s, enforce strict containment
T4_T5_spindle_events.T5_metric: median event RMS of the unthresholded 11-16 Hz signal
T4_T5_spindle_events.zero_event_rule: T4 density is zero; T5 is NOT_ESTIMABLE if fewer than 10 retained events

T4_added_event_attribution.comparison: The classifier is context-indexed by the canonical attribution_domain_table. It is evaluated separately for every positive Level-A worker candidate, every positive Level-B policy candidate, and the actually selected positive Level-A verifier condition. Only Level-A worker d=+1.5, repetition 0.85 Hz, carrier 13 Hz versus its exact paired sham contributes autonomous_added_event_fraction-0.50 to F_TARGET_DECISIONS; every other context is policy, surface, or verifier diagnostic only.
T4_added_event_attribution.event_time: For each retained spindle event, peak_sample is the earliest stored 200 Hz sample attaining the maximum frozen RMS envelope inside the event. Event IDs are assigned by onset sample then offset sample.
T4_added_event_attribution.candidate_match: Create every sham/intervention event pair with abs(intervention_peak_sample-sham_peak_sample)<=50 samples (0.250 s).
T4_added_event_attribution.one_to_one_algorithm: Sort candidate pairs lexicographically by absolute peak difference, intervention peak sample, sham peak sample, intervention event ID, sham event ID. Traverse once; accept a pair only when neither event is already matched. This greedy result is final.
T4_added_event_attribution.added_and_lost: Every unmatched intervention event is ADDED. Every unmatched sham event is LOST. Matched events are PAIRED_EXISTING. No many-to-one matching, rematching, or amplitude-based matching is permitted.
T4_added_event_attribution.packet_schedule_for_attribution: Resolve d and f_c from the unique attribution_domain_table row and apply attribution_domain_contract.packet_schedule exactly. Level-A worker and possible verifier rows use f_c=13; each Level-B row uses its enumerated 11-15 Hz carrier. The emitted packet table, not an inferred delay, is the sole attribution input.
T4_added_event_attribution.packet_association: An ADDED event is associated with an actually emitted packet when packet_start_sample<=event_peak_sample<packet_stop_sample+50. If multiple qualify, select smallest abs(event_peak_sample-packet_stop_sample), then earlier packet_start_sample, then lexicographically smaller packet_id. Otherwise classify UNASSOCIATED_ADDED.
T4_added_event_attribution.post_packet_autonomous_cycle: On the frozen 11-16 Hz filtered signal, enumerate upward zero crossings z where sigma[z-1]<0 and sigma[z]>=0. A packet-associated ADDED event has an autonomous post-packet cycle only if two successive crossings z1,z2 satisfy packet_stop_sample<z1<z2<event_offset_sample and 13<=z2-z1<=19 samples. The crossings must both lie strictly inside that same event.
T4_added_event_attribution.class_rule: Packet-associated with a qualifying post-offset cycle is AUTONOMOUS_PACKET_ASSOCIATED_ADDED; packet-associated without one is PACKET_REPLICA_ADDED; no packet association is UNASSOCIATED_ADDED.

attribution_domain_contract.row_contract_application: Every attribution_domain_table row must contain row_contract_id=T4_ATTRIBUTION_ROW_CONTRACT_V4. The packet schedule, paired-sham rule, domain-row pooling unit, event metrics, base attribution minimum, missingness, bootstrap-zero-added rule, and required-log schema in this object apply without override to every row; the row supplies its exact context, condition, dose, carrier, block universe, denominators, family, and use.
attribution_domain_contract.join_rule: Every positive T4 condition referenced by Level-A G4, Level-B C4/G4, or a selected verifier T4 row must match exactly one attribution_domain_table row on the four-field join key. Zero matches, duplicate matches, a candidate absent from the table, or a table row outside the frozen candidate arrays is PF_T4_ATTRIBUTION_DOMAIN_FAIL and stops before scientific execution.
attribution_domain_contract.packet_schedule: For every row, p=0,1,...; stored start s_p=floor(p*200/0.85+0.5), global internal start j_p=30000+5*s_p, stored stop=s_p+100, and retain exactly j_p+500<=210000. For k=0,...,499, q[k;f_c]=0.5*(1-cos(2*pi*k/499))*0.5*(1+sin(2*pi*f_c*k/1000)); the positive row emits u_T=d*q and u_E=u_I=u_R=0. The emitted packet table is the sole association input.
attribution_domain_contract.paired_sham: Within the row's execution context, pair intervention and sham only when parameter_draw_id and seed are identical and the initial state, 210 s duration, solver settings, and complete OU innovation arrays are byte-identical; sham has u_E=u_I=u_T=u_R=0 and supplies the fixed detector thresholds. A block has exactly one intervention and one sham record.
attribution_domain_contract.pooling_unit: One attribution pool is one domain_row_id across that row's valid complete paired blocks. Pool ADDED events only after blockwise matching/classification. Never pool across execution contexts, doses, carriers, repetitions, inactive verifier alternatives, or formal and diagnostic rows.
attribution_domain_contract.event_metrics: N_added=count(ADDED); N_autonomous=count(AUTONOMOUS_PACKET_ASSOCIATED_ADDED); N_packet_replica=count(PACKET_REPLICA_ADDED); F_auto=N_autonomous/N_added; F_replica=N_packet_replica/N_added. UNASSOCIATED_ADDED remains in N_added and neither numerator.

base_attribution_minimum.contributing_block_definition: A valid complete paired block with at least one ADDED intervention event in this exact domain row.

attribution_domain_contract.missingness: If N_added<30, fewer than 10 distinct row-specific contributing blocks exist, the paired sham is absent/invalid, or any required event/packet/crossing field is invalid, then F_auto, F_replica, and every C4/G4 or verifier scalar depending on this row are NOT_ESTIMABLE. Do not substitute zero, borrow another row, or pool another context. An inactive verifier alternative is NOT_LAUNCHED_BY_POLICY, not scientific missingness.
attribution_domain_contract.bootstrap_zero_added: Only after the point-estimate base attribution minimum passes: within each registered hierarchical bootstrap replicate, re-pool events from that row's resampled blocks. If its resampled N_added=0, set F_auto=0 and F_replica=1 for that replicate and log ZERO_ADDED_BOOTSTRAP with domain_row_id, family_id, and replicate_index. Do not use this convention to rescue a failed point-estimate denominator.

attribution_domain_table.bootstrap_family: F_TARGET_DECISIONS shared resample index tensor from PCG64(860218); F_auto/F_replica are computed as policy diagnostics but excluded from the formal family maximum M_b for this row
F_TARGET_DECISIONS shared resample index tensor from PCG64(860218); F_auto/F_replica are computed as policy diagnostics but excluded from the formal family maximum M_b for this row

attribution_domain_table.bootstrap_family: F_CROSS_TARGET_8X8 using PCG64(860221) if this is the frozen selected row

attribution_domain_table.bootstrap_family: F_CROSS_TARGET_8X8 using PCG64(860221) if this is the frozen selected row

attribution_domain_table.bootstrap_family: F_CROSS_TARGET_8X8 using PCG64(860221) if this is the frozen selected row

domain_cardinality_assertions.candidate_equality_rule: The sorted domain_row_id projection for each execution_context must equal its candidate_domain_rows array exactly; set difference, duplicate row_id, or duplicate join key is PF_T4_ATTRIBUTION_DOMAIN_FAIL.

T4_added_event_attribution.denominator: Resolve the exact attribution_domain_table row, pool only that row's ADDED events across its valid complete paired blocks, and apply both its context-specific complete-block minimum and the common N_added>=30/from>=10-contributing-block minimum. F_auto and F_replica are row-specific and never borrowed. The formal target-decision denominator is solely T4_LA_WORKER_D1P50_FC13.
T4_added_event_attribution.simultaneous_inference: Only F_auto(T4_LA_WORKER_D1P50_FC13)-0.50 is a member of F_TARGET_DECISIONS. Level-B positive rows enter their enumerated F_LEVEL_B_SURFACES C4 members; the actually selected verifier row supplies F_auto/F_replica only to F_CROSS_TARGET_8X8. Other Level-A worker rows are point-policy diagnostics. Every context uses the common row-specific bootstrap-zero-added rule.
T4_added_event_attribution.decision_and_grade_scope: PASS/D/F/NOT_ESTIMABLE below is the formal T4 target decision for T4_LA_WORKER_D1P50_FC13 plus the registered endpoint density contrast. Nonformal domain rows receive only ESTIMABLE_DIAGNOSTIC, NOT_ESTIMABLE, INVALID, or NOT_LAUNCHED_BY_POLICY status and cannot change the formal comparison.

decision_and_grade.PASS: N_added and block minima pass, simultaneous lower 95% bound for F_auto-0.50 is >0, T4 density criteria pass, and no artifact/stability veto fires.
decision_and_grade.D: Classifier and denominator are valid with F_replica<0.50, but the density margin fails, F_auto point estimate is <0.50, or its simultaneous lower bound is <=0.
decision_and_grade.F: F_replica>=0.50, or matching/detector/packet-timing error, instability, threshold drift, or direct-forcing artifact materially generates the apparent density effect.
decision_and_grade.NOT_ESTIMABLE: N_added<30, fewer than 10 blocks contain ADDED events, or required event/paired-sham data are undefined without an artifact finding.

T4_added_event_attribution.required_log: Exactly observation_and_detector_contract.T4_added_event_attribution.attribution_domain_contract.required_log_fields for every executed domain row; logs are partitioned by domain_row_id and include inactive verifier alternatives in a policy-selection manifest with status NOT_LAUNCHED_BY_POLICY.

fixture_manifest.comparison: Execute the classifier on only the manifest raw tables and apply comparison_contract exactly. Deep inequality, unconsumed input, exception, or type/order mismatch yields PF_T4_EVENT_ATTRIBUTION_FAIL and stops before Phase 2A.

T6.phase: Hilbert angle of the 0.3-1.5 Hz filtered signal
T6.amplitude: absolute Hilbert transform of the 11-16 Hz filtered signal
T6.formula: MI=(log(18)+sum_j(P_j*log(P_j)))/log(18), where P_j is mean sigma amplitude in bin j divided by the sum across bins; 0*log(0)=0
T6.surrogate_rule: Let lags=np.arange(2000,34001,dtype=int64), inclusive 10.000 through 170.000 s at 200 Hz. Instantiate Generator(PCG64(seed+600000)) once per run, draw choice(lags,size=200,replace=False), and in returned order compute each surrogate with np.roll(amplitude_envelope,+lag). Subtract the median of the 200 surrogate MI values; negative corrected values are retained.
T6.validity: all 18 phase bins populated, at least 30 SO cycles and at least 10 spindle events

T7.metric: circular mean SO phase of within-spindle sigma-envelope maxima
T7.formula: atan2(sum(sin(phi_e)),sum(cos(phi_e))) in [-pi,pi); ties in envelope maxima use earliest sample
T7.validity: at least 10 spindle events, at least 30 SO cycles, and R>=0.20

exact_phase_response_statistics.input_conditions: Use all eight complete Level-A requested phases alpha_l in their registered order for formal T7. For Level-B policy scoring use the four complete canonical phases [-pi,-pi/2,0,pi/2] in that order.
exact_phase_response_statistics.observed_phase_per_block_condition: beta_b,l=atan2(sum_e sin(phi_e),sum_e cos(phi_e)) in [-pi,pi), using all valid spindle events in block b and condition l. A condition is missing if fewer than 10 events, fewer than 30 SO cycles, concentration R<0.20, or resultant magnitude<=1e-12.
exact_phase_response_statistics.wrap: wrap(x)=atan2(sin(x),cos(x)); exact +pi returned by atan2 is canonicalized to -pi.
exact_phase_response_statistics.rho_c_per_block: Let P={(l,m):0<=l<m<L}. rho_b=sum_(l,m in P)[sin(alpha_l-alpha_m)*sin(beta_b,l-beta_b,m)]/sqrt(sum_P sin(alpha_l-alpha_m)^2 * sum_P sin(beta_b,l-beta_b,m)^2). Enumerate pairs lexicographically by l then m and accumulate float64 sums in that order.
exact_phase_response_statistics.rho_degeneracy: If either pairwise squared-sine sum is <=1e-12, rho_b is missing; otherwise rho_b is dimensionless in [-1,1].
exact_phase_response_statistics.tracking_error_per_block_radians: e_b=median_l(abs(wrap(beta_b,l-alpha_l))); for an even number of conditions median is the arithmetic mean of the two central sorted float64 values.
exact_phase_response_statistics.aggregate: For each context take rho_c=median_b(rho_b), tracking_error=median_b(e_b), and separation=median_b(s_b) over blocks complete for every required phase. Formal Level A requires >=30 blocks, >=5 seeds, >=5 draws; Level B requires >=10 of 12 blocks, >=3 seeds, all 3 draws; cross-target verification requires >=20 of 24 blocks, >=3 verifier seeds, >=5 draws.
exact_phase_response_statistics.target_score: G7=min(rho_c/0.70,min(4,(pi/6)/max(tracking_error,1e-12)),separation/(pi/3)). Larger is better and G7=1 is the joint practical-margin boundary.
exact_phase_response_statistics.correlation_definition: Fisher-Lee pairwise circular-circular correlation, which remains defined for the symmetric registered requested-phase grid without requiring a circular mean of alpha.

T8.retained_interval: The common 10 s edge exclusion applies. The retained half-open interval is analysis time [10,170) s, stored samples [2000,34000) at 200 Hz.
T8.placement_rationale: Six adjacent 25 s windows occupy the centered 150 s subinterval [15,165), leaving 5 s unused at each side of the already edge-retained [10,170) interval.
T8.filter_and_threshold_scope: Compute the registered zero-phase SO and sigma filters once on the complete 180 s analysis signal. Calibrate spindle high/low thresholds once from the paired sham over retained [10,170) s. Apply those unchanged filtered arrays and thresholds to all six windows and all paired intervention conditions.
T8.strict_event_containment: An SO or spindle event contributes to a window only if its onset, offset, and detector extrema/peak samples are all strictly greater than the window start sample and strictly less than the window stop sample. Boundary-touching and cross-window events contribute to no T8 window and are logged once as T8_BOUNDARY_REJECT.

per_window_welch.peak_refinement: three-bin parabolic interpolation in log power; use the discrete bin when the maximum is at either peak-band boundary

T8.window_is_valid_regime: all rates finite and their means in [0.5,60] Hz; dominant SO peak in [0.5,1.25] Hz; SO median peak-to-peak in [0.10,2.00] m.u.; SO density in [10,90] events/min; spindle density in [0.5,20] events/min; and 11-16 Hz power divided by 4-30 Hz power in [0.02,0.60]
T8.transition_persistence: an intervention-induced regime requires at least two consecutive valid-regime windows
T8.invalidity: solver or state invalidity is never a regime transition

persistence_and_adjacency_decision.per_block_persistence: For condition u and block b, P_b(u)=1 iff at least one ordered adjacent window pair (W1,W2),(W2,W3),(W3,W4),(W4,W5),(W5,W6) has both windows valid-regime; otherwise P_b(u)=0. A boundary-rejected or invalid window is not valid.
persistence_and_adjacency_decision.aggregate_persistence: P(u)=mean_b P_b(u) over complete paired blocks. The registered persistence boundary is 0.75; equality passes a point prerequisite, while a confirmatory simultaneous slack passes only with lower bound P-0.75>0.
persistence_and_adjacency_decision.level_a_high_occupancy_condition: For each dose d compute O_hat(d)=median_b O_b(d). Let d_hi maximize O_hat over [-2,-1.25,-0.5,0,0.5,1.25,2]; exact ties choose smaller abs(d), then smaller signed d. Formal T8 requires P(d_hi)>=0.75 and the simultaneous lower bound for P(d_hi)-0.75>0.
persistence_and_adjacency_decision.level_a_oriented_support: For each nonzero dose d define Q(d)=median_b[sign(d)*(O_b(d)-O_b(0))]. Dose d supports its registered direction iff Q(d)>0 with >=30 complete blocks, >=5 seeds, and >=5 draws; equality or missing fails.
persistence_and_adjacency_decision.level_a_adjacency_pass: PASS iff at least one listed pair (d1,d2) has Q(d1)>0 and Q(d2)>0. Negative and positive sides are never treated as adjacent across zero.
persistence_and_adjacency_decision.level_b_oriented_support: At each fixed exposure fraction f, Q_f(d)=median_b[sign(d)*(O_b(d,f)-O_b(0,f))] over >=10 of 12 blocks, >=3 seeds, and all 3 draws.
persistence_and_adjacency_decision.level_b_ordered_adjacency_pairs_by_fract: At each f independently the only pairs are (-2,-1) and (1,2). A Level-B T8 condition (d,f) is policy-eligible only if d belongs to a pair for which both Q_f values are strictly >0.
persistence_and_adjacency_decision.tie_and_missing: All comparisons use raw float64 values with no tolerance. Equality Q=0 is not support. Any missing dose, paired sham, persistence value, or required denominator makes that pair fail; it is never skipped to create adjacency.
